english.note: Use it before an item noun when the material or clothing feature is elastic, such as in 橡筋褲.

examples.english: I bought a pair of elastic-waisted trousers that do not feel tight around my waist when I run.
examples.traditional: 我買咗條橡筋褲，跑步嗰陣唔會箍住條腰。
